dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: I work as a miner, or at least that's what I used to do. Now that the Chasm's been sealed off, I just wander around without a job to do.

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: I've heard that limited production has resumed, but I wasn't put on the list of workers.

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Maybe if I had something to do, I wouldn't be so picky about what to eat. But now that I've already tried all the places around here, I don't have a clue what I want to eat today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you sure you'll be alright unemployed?

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: You needn't worry!

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Seeing as you don't appear to be a Millelith, I'll let you in on something.

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: When I was working down in the Chasm, I moved some raw materials out on the sly. I'm talking real high quality stuff, like what Shitou has at The Jade Mystery. People would buy it by the boatload!

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Actually, I've been looking for a partner. Whaddya think? Are you in?

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Imagine, you'll be able to eat and drink whatever you please, just as if Yujing Terrace was your very own kitchen!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't that against the law?

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: What are you trying to say? ...You're not going to turn me in to the Millelith, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: ...Ugh, fine, just take these. They're left over from my mining days.

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Now... mum's the word, you got it? Not a whisper of this, not to anybody!

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: *sigh* Seems like I've already tried every place there is to eat around here, and I'm already tired of all of them...

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: What a bother, I guess I'll have to go someplace further.

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Don't forget to come back and recommend any good restaurants you find!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything good to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Hmm, from my sampling, there's really not much to those big restaurants.

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Li Cuisine, Yue Cuisine, delicacies and delectables... What matters is the concept and atmosphere. And if you really want to know what's best, I say it has to be the snacks at Chihu Rock!

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: Zhongyuan Chop Suey, Grilled Tiger Fish... When Rex Lapis came to visit Chihu Rock back in the day, he too was enticed by the smells of the roadside stalls.

dialogues.speaker: Qian
dialogues.text: The accumulated aromas of a thousand years waft through this street. All who pass through can't help but salivate!
